backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor defining the freelance marketplace backend with user profiles, job postings, and proposals, including role-based access control and blob storage mixins.
feature_evidence.json: Empty feature evidence report with no recorded features.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON document containing one-line summaries of all frontend source files for build planning reference.
frontend/index.css: Root CSS file importing Tailwind directives and defining OKLCH-based CSS custom properties for light and dark themes including colors, borders, and sidebar tokens.
frontend/index.html: Minimal HTML entry point mounting the React app at the #root div and loading the main TypeScript module.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component that sets up TanStack Router with all application routes (login, role selection, dashboards, job details, proposals, profiles) wrapped in ThemeProvider and Toaster.
frontend/src/components/JobCard.tsx: Reusable card component rendering a job's title, description, budget, category, open/closed status badge, optional proposal count, and an optional action slot.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: App shell component providing a sticky header with logo, role-aware navigation links, a user avatar dropdown (dashboard, profile, logout), and a main content area.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom hook that creates and caches an authenticated or anonymous ICP actor using React Query, reinitializing and invalidating dependent queries whenever the identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides a React context and hook for Internet Identity authentication, including login, logout, and identity state management using DFINITY's AuthClient.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for all backend interactions including user profiles, jobs, and proposals using the actor from useActor.
frontend/src/index.css: Global CSS file that sets up Tailwind, imports Inter and Sora fonts, and defines light/dark mode CSS custom properties for the design system's color palette.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that renders the React app wrapped with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/pages/CreateJobPage.tsx: Page component for customers to post a new job, with a form for title, description, budget, and category, guarded by auth and role checks.
frontend/src/pages/CustomerDashboard.tsx: Dashboard page for customers showing stats and a list of their posted jobs, with navigation guards ensuring only authenticated customers can access it.
frontend/src/pages/FreelancerDashboard.t: Dashboard page for freelancers displaying open jobs with search/category filtering and a summary of submitted proposals, with role-based access guards.
frontend/src/pages/FreelancerProfilePage: Displays a public freelancer profile page fetched by userId, showing name, hourly rate, bio, skills, and a resume download button, with loading skeleton and not-found states.
frontend/src/pages/JobDetailsPage.tsx: Shows details of a specific job and lists submitted proposals with a ProposalCard component that allows the job owner to view freelancer profiles and accept proposals.
frontend/src/pages/LoginPage.tsx: Landing/login page that authenticates users via Internet Identity and redirects them to the appropriate dashboard or role-selection page based on their profile.
frontend/src/pages/ProfileEditPage.tsx: Form page for freelancers to edit their profile including display name, bio, skills, hourly rate, and resume upload, with pre-filled existing data and redirect guards.
frontend/src/pages/RoleSelectionPage.tsx: Onboarding page where newly authenticated users choose between customer and freelancer roles, then get redirected to the corresponding dashboard after role assignment.
frontend/src/pages/SubmitProposalPage.ts: A React page that allows authenticated freelancers to submit a proposal (cover letter and proposed price) for a specific job, with guards redirecting non-freelancers or already-applied users.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for extracting URL query parameters from both regular and hash-based routing, persisting them in sessionStorage, and cleaning sensitive params from the URL hash.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining custom fonts, OKLCH-based color tokens, border radii, box shadows, and animations for the FreelanceApp's design system.
project_state.json: Project state metadata describing the FreelanceApp's implemented features (role selection, customer/freelancer modes, profiles, theming) and pending architectural requests, at schema version 1.0.0.
